<Helmet>

tasks.title: Appointment Booking System (Calendly Functions)
tasks.description: Build complete appointment system with artist availability config, public booking widget, Jitsi video rooms, iCal downloads, and admin interface for managing bookings
tasks.details:
Port from xena-horizon-platform (3) to packages/ui/src/super-profile/rendezvous/:

Firestore collections:
- members/{uid}/agenda/config: {durée, tampon, délai_minimal, horizon, fuseau, jours: {[0-6]: PlageHoraire[]}, exceptions: {[YYYY-MM-DD]: PlageHoraire[]}}
  - PlageHoraire: {debut: 'HH:MM', fin: 'HH:MM'}
  - Public read, owner write
- rendezvousPro/{id}: {artisteUid, uid, nom, courriel, debut: Timestamp, fin: Timestamp, duree: number, statut: 'demande'|'confirme'|'annule'|'complete', salle: string, note?, noteAdmin?, creePar: 'client'|'artiste', createdAt, updatedAt}
  - Read: artiste OR client (uid match), Write: writeBatch with getAfter() guard
- occupationsPro/{id}: {artisteUid, debut: Timestamp, fin: Timestamp}
  - Public read (no personal data), created in batch with rendezvous

Public booking widget (PriseRendezVous.tsx mounted in template sections):
1. Fetch agenda/config and occupationsPro for artist
2. Calculate available slots: artist's jours + exceptions, minus occupations, respecting délai_minimal and horizon
3. Display calendar with available time slots
4. On booking: if user not authenticated, create account (createUserWithEmailAndPassword with 48-char random password, updateProfile with nom, sendPasswordResetEmail with url='/createur')
5. writeBatch: create rendezvousPro + occupationsPro
6. Jitsi room: meet.jit.si/salon-{id}, accessible 10min before to 30min after
7. Generate .ics file for download (iCal format with VEVENT)

Artist admin (AgendaAdmin.tsx in ProfilProAdmin):
- Disponibilités tab: configure jours, exceptions, durée, tampon, délai_minimal, horizon, fuseau
- Rendez-vous tab: list all appointments (upcoming/past), actions: confirmer, annuler, add noteAdmin
- Display appointee info: nom, courriel, date/time, statut, Jitsi room link (when active)

Firestore rules:
- agenda/config: public read, owner write
- rendezvousPro: read if artisteUid==uid OR uid==request.auth.uid, create with validation (artisteUid matches, debut < fin, future date)
- occupationsPro: public read, write in batch only (validated via getAfter)
tasks.testStrategy: Test availability calculation: set artist jours to Mon-Fri 9-17, create occupations for Mon 10-11 and 14-15, verify available slots exclude those times and respect tampon/délai. Test booking flow as guest: enter name/email, book slot, verify account created with random password, password reset email sent, rendezvous and occupation created in batch. Test as authenticated user: verify no account creation, immediate booking. Test Jitsi room: verify URL format, accessible window (10min before to 30min after). Test .ics download: verify VEVENT with correct DTSTART, DTEND, SUMMARY. Test admin: confirm booking (status→confirme), cancel (status→annule), add noteAdmin. Run emulator tests: verify non-owner can't write agenda/config, can't read other's appointments, can't create occupation without matching rendezvous.

tasks.title: Stripe Subscription & Payment Integration
tasks.description: Implement Stripe Checkout subscription flow ($100 CAD/month), webhook handling for subscription lifecycle, customer portal, Interac alternative, and proEnabled flag management
tasks.details:
Create functions/src/profilPro.ts with Firebase Functions v2:

1. creerAbonnementProfilPro (onCall, authenticated):
   - Get/create Stripe customer by uid in abonnementsPro/{uid}
   - Create Checkout session: mode='subscription', price_data={unit_amount: 10000, currency: 'cad', recurring: {interval: 'month'}}
   - metadata: {projet: 'creator-studio-pro', uid}
   - client_reference_id: uid
   - success_url: /createur?pro=merci, cancel_url: /createur?pro=annule
   - Return session URL

2. webhookProfilPro (onRequest):
   - Verify Stripe signature manually (crypto.createHmac, no Stripe SDK) like stripeCampingWebhook
   - Filter: only process events with metadata.projet=='creator-studio-pro'
   - Events: checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.updated, customer.subscription.deleted
   - On success: write abonnementsPro/{uid} {statut, stripeCustomerId, stripeSubscriptionId, periodeFin, montant}, set members/{uid}/admin/flags.proEnabled=true
   - On deletion: set flags.proEnabled=false
   - Send welcome email via Zoho (ZOHO_USER, ZOHO_PASS from secrets)

3. portailProfilPro (onCall, authenticated):
   - Create Stripe customer portal session
   - Return portal URL for subscription management

Secrets to configure:
- STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (already present per docs)
- STRIPE_WEBHOOK_PRO_SECRET (set after webhook endpoint creation)
- ZOHO_USER, ZOHO_PASS (already present)

Client-side (packages/ui/src/super-profile/abonnement.ts):
- Call creerAbonnementProfilPro → redirect to Stripe Checkout
- Call portailProfilPro → open customer portal
- Subscribe to abonnementsPro/{uid} for status display
- Display Interac option: 'Vous préférez un virement Interac ? Envoyez 100 $ à alex@lesalondesinconnus.com avec votre nom d'artiste en message, et votre Profil Pro s'allume dans la journée.'

Export functions from functions/src/index.ts (integration step)

Firestore rules:
- abonnementsPro/{uid}: owner read only (no write, functions write via admin SDK)

Test portal: call portailProfilPro, verify portal URL returned and valid. Test client subscription: verify abonnementsPro/{uid} read succeeds for owner, fails for other user.
